lastCompletedStory.title: Gitignore the three untracked runtime artifacts

nextStoryContext: US-001 only touched .gitignore, adding .claude/.cam-sidecar-session.json, .claude/.cam-ship-stalled.json, and .claude/.cam-plan-preflight-failed.json next to the existing .cam-plan-escalated.json entry (line ~85). src/supervisor/plan-preflight.ts was left untouched (AC7): its --porcelain gate is not to be loosened. US-002 is next: create src/supervisor/plan-preflight-marker.ts mirroring src/supervisor/plan-escalation.ts (the closest sibling: filename constant, { step, detail, writtenAt } interface with no issueId, Omit<Marker, 'writtenAt'> writer-params type, shape-guarded read returning null on any malformation, write/remove that never throw, plus a pure single-line-vs-multiline truncation helper). Field name is writtenAt (not ts, which is what ship-stalled uses).
